change: In the wide FP16 full-y output pass, reuse the retained-y tile in gammaBuf_ as the output destination after it is loaded into FP32 scratch. Apply inverse RMS, convert back to half, apply gamma/bias in-place, and Store from that same tile. FP32/BF16 paths and reduction scratch are unchanged.
hypothesis: Eliminating outputBuf_ as an active FP16 tile avoids an additional UB bank target during the output sequence and stores directly from the retained-y bank. This may improve or worsen bank interaction; performance is unmeasured.
